final_message:
Done. `src/diff.ts` now implements all three functions per the README rules:

- **`diffLines`** builds a suffix LCS-length table (`Uint32Array`), then greedily emits ops front-to-back: keep on equal lines; otherwise `del` from `a` when dropping it doesn't reduce the common-subsequence length, else `add` from `b` — so kept lines form an LCS and ties break by deleting first (README.md:16-25). Verified against the README's `[del x, keep y, add z]` example.
- **`renderDiff`** joins `  line` / `- line` / `+ line` with `\n`; **`diffStats`** counts each op kind.

`npm test` passes (3/3). Note: `npx tsc` couldn't run — the registry is blocked in this environment — but Node 24's TS handling parses the file cleanly and all tests pass.
